reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 editorial review of 40 original verb exercises, all full German sentences, 160 offered choices, naturalness, grammar and bilingual feedback. Source gloss corrections: verschlafen past-form English, vertreten unnatural inherited construction, vertrauen dative, versorgen two meanings, verstreichen time sense and legal verurteilen. Compared relevant existing objectives in production, initial, B2, workplace and general-expansion catalogs; human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approval pending.
